$comment: Sample content for the App Store screens (bipe#462). One entry per capture slug, text per locale. People are cast ids (product/cast.json); `me` is the viewer. Messages from people are in people's voice ("pra" is fine). tools/gen.mjs validates this file and writes BipeStoreFixtures.swift; the iOS screenshot mode reads it. `minute`: the time shown is 10:<minute> on the capture day.
